title.en: narrative voice and free indirect discourse: first person, third person, omniscient, unreliable narrator, free indirect

explain.ko: 서술 시점(point of view)은 독자의 이해를 좌우합니다. 1인칭은 친밀하지만 제한적이고, 3인칭 전지적 시점(omniscient)은 모든 인물의 속마음을 압니다. 신뢰할 수 없는 서술자(unreliable narrator)는 독자를 오도합니다. 자유간접화법(free indirect discourse)은 따옴표 없이 서술자와 인물의 목소리를 섞어 인물의 생각을 직접 전달하며(What was she to do now?), 서술자와 인물 사이의 거리와 아이러니를 만들어 냅니다.
explain.en: Point of view shapes the reader's understanding. First person is intimate but limited, while the third-person omniscient viewpoint knows every character's mind. An unreliable narrator misleads the reader. Free indirect discourse blends the narrator's and character's voices without quotation marks, conveying a character's thoughts directly (What was she to do now?), and creates distance and irony between narrator and character.

items.passage:
LITERARY COLUMN
Whose voice is it?
Free indirect discourse blurs the boundary between narrator and character. A character's thoughts seep into the narration without quotation marks. So readers keep asking whose judgement it is.

prompt.en: Write the same scene in first person, third person and free indirect discourse (three sentences plus one explanatory sentence).

task.model: First person: I opened the letter and held my breath. Third person: She opened the letter and held her breath. Free indirect discourse: She opened the letter. Could this really be possible? The narrator's and character's voices blend.
